asignatura: INICIACIÓN A HABILIDADES COMUNICATIVAS EN INGLÉS(B)
resumen:
Comprehension is showing you understand a text by answering questions about it (p. 12).
It is an everyday life skill and requires linking facts and clues (p. 12; slide 2).
Six reading strategies: active reading, context, summarise, visualise, ask questions, put clues together (p. 12-13).
Comprehension = literal understanding + meaning + intention + interpretation; harder the longer the text (slide 4).
Practice: British Council 'Millennials in the workplace' reading (p. 13).

conceptos.definicion: When you read a text and show you understand it by answering questions, this is called comprehension.

esquemas.titulo: How to answer a comprehension question
pasos: Read: 'Tommy is wearing a grey jumper, round glasses and a blue hat'
Question: What colour hat is Tommy wearing?
Answer: 'Tommy is wearing a blue hat' → you have understood
